# SMT Solving

## SAT Solving

1. Equivalent CNF formula contains $2^n$ clauses (each time we must distribuate: $A \lor (B \land C) = (A \lor B) \land (A \lor C))$

3. Example
$$P = r \land (q \lor \neg r) \land (s \lor \neg r) \land (p \lor \neg q \lor \neg s) \land (\neg p \lor \neg q \lor \neg s)$$
$$P[r] = q \land s \land (p \lor \neg q \lor \neg s) \land (\neg p \lor \neg q \lor \neg s)$$
$$P[r, q] = s \land (p \lor \neg s) \land (\neg p \lor \neg s)$$
$$P[r, q, s] = p \land \neg p$$
$$P[r, q, s, p] = False$$

4. Candy box

$$P = (A \lor B \lor C) \land (A \Longrightarrow B) \land (\neg A \Longrightarrow \neg B) \land ((A \land B) \Longrightarrow C) \land ((\neg A \land \neg B) \Longrightarrow \neg C)$$
$$P = (A \lor B \lor C) \land (\neg A \lor B) \land (A \lor \neg B) \land (\neg A \lor \neg B \lor C) \land (A \lor B \lor \neg C)$$
$$P[A] = B \land (\neg B \lor C)$$
$$P[A, B] = C$$
$$P[A, B, C] = True$$

$A \Longrightarrow B$

To check if proof $P$ is valid:

proof that $\neg P$ is unsatifiable !!

So $\neg (A \Longrightarrow B) \equiv A \land \neg B$ is unsatifiable

$$P = (A \lor B \lor C) \land (\neg A \lor B) \land (A \lor \neg B) \land (\neg A \lor \neg B \lor C) \land (A \lor B \lor \neg C) \land (\neg A \lor \neg B \lor \neg C)$$
$$P[A] = B \land (\neg B \lor C) \land (\neg B \lor \neg C)$$
$$P[A, B] = C \land \neg C$$
$$P[A, B, C] = False$$
